name: aquamirage-whisper-printed-spellshroud-spell-cannot-target-it
notes: Aquamirage Whisper: printed Spellshroud -- an opposing spell cannot target it. Aquamirage Whisper (3n5x9fbkn0, REGALIA,WEAPON): "Spellshroud (This object can't be targeted by Spells.)" -- the Spellshroud is the card's own, UNCONDITIONAL keyword (rules: .claude/GrandArchiveSim/refs/comprehensive-rules.md, Keywords > Spellshroud 1: "This can't be targeted by spells"). It was never implemented: HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (Data/ProcessKeywordsGA.php has no Spellshroud keyword, so function_exists is false); 3n5x9fbkn0 was in neither, so FilterSpellshroudTargets() kept the card in the target list. Fixed: it is now in HasSpellshroud()'s printed-Spellshroud table (after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates). Player 2 controls the holder plus a Mirrordepth's Blade; player 1 plays Fracturize ("Target item or weapon becomes a Cleric Fractal phantasia ...", a Spell): the target prompt offers ONLY the Mirrordepth's Blade, answering with the holder is refused (expectFailure) and the legal answer then resolves.

rulesClauses: Spellshroud: objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Aquamirage Whisper's printed Spellshroud was not implemented: a spell could target it. HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (Data/ProcessKeywordsGA.php has no Spellshroud keyword, so function_exists is false), and 3n5x9fbkn0 was in neither. Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): player 1's spell target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1&theirField-2' -- every holder was offered, and the first refused answer was accepted ('Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded'). Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for the printed-Spellshroud card IDs (static table after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for 3n5x9fbkn0; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
